fact: The ONS Director General recalled the national statistics strategy 2024-2028, stated as existing and resting on technological infrastructure, statistics training and wider cooperation, at a Finance Ministry information day held on Tuesday 19 November 2024.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2015-2025.
